Topics covered in this PDF

BHIC-107 (History of India IV (c. 1206-1550)) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Political chronicles of the Delhi Sultanate, the Sultanate ruling class, southern kingdoms and the Sultanate, new kingdoms in Assam, inland trade
  • The Mongol problem, the Nayankara system, currency system of the Delhi Sultans, Jain tradition, public works under the Delhi Sultanate

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: Tutor Marked Assignment, total marks 100. Assignment I: two questions in about 500 words (20 each). Assignment II: three questions in about 250 words (10 each). Assignment III: five questions in about 100 words (6 each)

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
